events.text: The peak was discovered and originally named Mount Kaufmann.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The peak was discovered in 1874 and originally named Mount Kaufmann

events.text: The mountain was renamed Lenin Peak.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1928 , the mountain was renamed Lenin Peak

events.text: In Tajikistan, the peak was renamed again.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In Tajikistan , the peak was renamed again in July 2006

events.text: Kyrgyz president Almazbek Atambayev called for renaming the peak Manas Peak.
events.subject: other
events.quote: in October 2017 , Kyrgyz president Almazbek Atambayev called for renaming the peak Manas Peak

events.text: Three mountaineers made the first attempt to reach the highest point of the Trans-Alai Range.
events.subject: self

events.text: They started climbing from the saddle along the NE Ridge.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On September 25 , 1928 they started climbing from the saddle along the NE Ridge

events.text: The title Lenin Peak was first applied to the highest point of the Trans-Alai Range.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The title Lenin Peak was first applied to the highest point of the Trans-Alai Range in the same year ( 1928 )
